title: A young bass player in the band and what Basie tells new players
summary: Basie says he listens to the band, not the bass player, and gives new players no direction; they listen and find their way.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique
